description: toolbox llm-toolchain open-ontologies 2.1.0: shacl without --verified reports no violation for sh:not [ sh:path p ; sh:hasValue v ] (alone or inside sh:or) on data that violates it, while conforms comes back null/true. sh:xone is listed under skipped_constraints. ontology/shapes.ttl works around both with sh:sparql. Repro: ontology shapes before the workaround in nix-whk. Upstream report not filed yet.
title: open-ontologies default SHACL evaluator passes sh:or/sh:not silently
